title: Birthday at Missouri Waterfall Kills 26-Year-Old Indian Engineer
excerpt: Singireddy Sai Srihari Krishna, freshly employed in St. Louis, drowned at Meramec State Park on his 26th birthday after being swept into a powerful current.
body:
A 26-year-old software engineer from Andhra Pradesh drowned at Meramec State Park in Missouri on April 11, 2026, while celebrating his birthday with colleagues. Singireddy Sai Srihari Krishna had stepped into the river pool at the base of a waterfall and was swept away by a current so strong that neither his friends nor arriving emergency responders could reach him in time.

**What happened at the park:**
Krishna traveled to Meramec State Park near Sullivan — roughly an hour southwest of St. Louis — with two Telugu colleagues to mark his 26th birthday. He entered the river voluntarily, but officials say underwater vegetation and a powerful whirlpool-like current pulled him under. Emergency responders from the Sullivan fire department recovered his body after an extensive search.

**Who Krishna was:**
Krishna hailed from Piridi village in Vizianagaram district, Andhra Pradesh, and had moved to the United States in 2022 for a master's degree. He had joined Elessent Clean Technologies in St. Louis in December 2025 — barely four months before his death. His family describes him as an avid swimmer who had coached swimming during his student years, making the tragedy all the more shattering. His parents, Srinivasa Rao and Ramadevi, who remain in India, are now awaiting repatriation of his remains.

**What to watch:**
Authorities have classified the death as accidental drowning linked to hazardous water conditions, and his family is working with Indian consular officials to bring his body home — a process that can take weeks and carries significant financial burden for grieving families abroad.
